summary.es: ETH y BTC cerraron ayer un viaje de ida y vuelta completo: rompieron a maximos nuevos (ETH 1,849, BTC 64,811.8) y devolvieron casi todo, cerrando casi planos. summary.en: ETH and BTC closed out a full round trip yesterday: broke to new highs (ETH 1,849, BTC 64,811.8) and gave almost all of it back, closing nearly flat. Today they open right at that close, inside yesterday's VAL, with an A+ bounce zone (sweep of yesterday's low plus a 1h FVG, against the 24h move) on both coins. Conviction stays low: every measured prior today (funding, fear, DVOL, CME gap, hack headline) sits well under 40%, so there is no GO even though the zone grades A+. No active CME gap today (Tuesday) and no high-impact USD event in the window. Verdict: WAIT on ETH and BTC, watching the sweep of the low.
